strategic_assessment.achievement: The 200-Series has fulfilled its mission. Framework v2 moved from S200 discovery through S202 architecture, S203 engineering, S204 validation, S205 deployment authorization, S207 operational certification, and now S208 stewardship. The series closes with a complete architectural constitution: frozen principles, drift detection, expansion rules, registry authority, debt catalog, and v3 prevention.
strategic_assessment.transition: The 200-Series shifts permanently from designing Framework v2 to protecting it. Future sessions in the series are stewardship sessions — audit, drift detection, and principle enforcement. No new architecture design work is required.
strategic_assessment.risk_outlook: The primary architectural risk (architecture drift eroding Framework v2 gains) is now actively managed through the drift detection model (Board B), expansion rules (Board C), registry authority (Board F), and automatic stop conditions. Drift will still occur — but it will be detected, classified, and responded to before it becomes systemic.
strategic_assessment.next_highest_value_action: Remediate the 2 learner-safety debt items (TD-001: DL-016 metadata shift, TD-002: 39 Domain F DL-026 items). These are the only active learner-pool risks. All other debt can be addressed in certification waves or as part of natural content growth.
